changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_student ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, academy_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.customer(id), student_code VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, first_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, last_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, date_of_birth DATE, gender VARCHAR(30), email VARCHAR(255), phone VARCHAR(50), guardian_name VARCHAR(160), guardian_phone VARCHAR(50), guardian_email VARCHAR(255), address VARCHAR(1000), emergency_contact VARCHAR(100), notes VARCHAR(1000), status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('ACTIVE','INACTIVE')), created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, created_by VARCHAR(100), updated_by VARCHAR(100), UNIQUE (academy_id, student_code), UNIQUE (id, academy_id) ); CREATE INDEX academy_student_scope ON ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_student(academy_id, status, last_name, first_name); CREATE TABLE ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_student_sport ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, academy_id BIGINT NOT NULL, student_id BIGINT NOT NULL, sport_id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE (student_id, sport_id), FOREIGN KEY (student_id, academy_id) REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_student(id, academy_id), FOREIGN KEY (sport_id, academy_id) REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_sport(id, academy_id) ); CREATE INDEX academy_student_sport_scope ON ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_student_sport(academy_id, sport_id, student_id);
